name: smh_tr_group_land_ref-land2-COMMIT
purpose: West landing (north/south) master of the SM compact transport split; exact 4096-cycle full-width original-reference bench with the split composition + landing-latency mutant.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_smh_tr_group_land u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_SMH_RSTRELAY --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/sm/ot_hbm_smh_compact_transport.sv rtl/hbm_accel/sm/ot_hbm_smh_transport_split_masters.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/smh_tr_group_land_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/smh_tr_group_land_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/smh_tr_group_land_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_smh_tr_group_land  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: West beat transport split: beat_w (216x216, one W-face 2069-bit input forked to transit+north+south register sets; routed keep1-7ff908809 CLOSED TT +59.09 / FF +21.27 but native audit FAIL launch 227 / capture 463.1 / spread 82.4 ps because landing flops sat up to ~200 um from their W input pins) is replaced by the CLOSED 43.2x216 beat_e transit master (same 2-stage RTL body/reset mask) plus this ONE new one-edge landing master, hardened once and instanced twice (north, south). Input d on the S face (M5, 0.096 pitch), output q on the N face 43.2 um away, so every pin->D and Q->pin leg is <= ~43 um. Same 51 west logical slices and edge counts (transit 2, landing 1): 0 cycles, no compiler change. 2,069 sinks on one root. | land2: land1 CLOSED TT +288.90 / FF +19.22 / DRC 0, native audit capture 145.6 PASS (beat_w 463.1) but launch 222.5 > 220 on 5/2069 q pins (median 191.9): the recipe-2 outhold stage puts BUF->HB2->BUF between every q flop and its pin; the landing's q pins feed a die-level wire to a receiver whose own inhold covers hold, so the output hold stage is dropped (outhold false); pin flops stay FIRM at the N face. Same RTL/pins/cycles.
